# Tekalis

> Tekalis is an online electronics and high-tech store based in Dakar Fann, Senegal. We sell smartphones, laptops, TVs, home appliances, gaming equipment, air conditioners, solar energy systems, and tech accessories, with delivery throughout Senegal.

Welcome to Tekalis. The catalogue and store pages below are organized by product range and company information. Prices are shown in FCFA (XOF) on each product page; every product is covered by the manufacturer warranty (duration depends on the product).

## About

- [About Tekalis](https://tekalis.com/apropos): Company history, values and the Tekalis team in Dakar.
- [Contact](https://tekalis.com/contact): Contact form, phone +221 78 634 69 46 and email contact@tekalis.com.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://tekalis.com/faq): Answers to common questions about ordering, delivery and payment.
- [Delivery](https://tekalis.com/livraison): Express delivery in Dakar (24–48h), free from 50 000 FCFA of purchase, and 2–5 days for other regions.
- [Warranties](https://tekalis.com/garanties): Manufacturer warranty coverage on all products (duration depends on the product).
- [Returns](https://tekalis.com/retours): 7-day return and exchange policy.
- [Terms and conditions](https://tekalis.com/cgv): General terms and conditions of sale.

- [Audio](https://tekalis.com/category/audio): Headphones, speakers and audio gear.

Payment methods accepted: Wave, Orange Money, Free Money, cash on delivery, Visa and Mastercard.
